instruction: Browse the list of men's Jordan shorts between $40-$70.

metadata.explanation: Task variation: Browse men's Jordan shorts between $40-$70. Same pattern as original task (filter-based shopping on NBA.com), different filter criteria. Evaluator checks filter elements and URL contain the expected filters.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing check_direct_json_object metric and active_tab_html_parse getter with class&url category.

llm_judge_reasons: The evaluator correctly checks both UI state (filter elements with class 'filter-selector-link') and URL parameters to verify the filters are applied
The getter logic (active_tab_html_parse with class&url category) can extract filter elements from HTML and check URL for the expected filter parameters ($40-$70, men, shorts, jordan)
The metric logic (check_direct_json_object) correctly compares the boolean values to verify all required filters are present and no unexpected filters exist
The evaluation covers the complete instruction requirement: browsing men's Jordan shorts in the $40-$70 price range requires all 4 filters to be active
Case-insensitive matching for URL and text provides robustness
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding a postconfig to ensure the page is fully loaded before evaluation, as filter application may take time after navigation
